followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the residual nonresident foreign-tourist entry prohibition as a formal policy period. Clarify inward travel and residual cohort in Dimensions. Neighbouring-country pilots, citizens/residents and exceptional permissions are excluded; the2020 pilot used airport/ferry facilities. Retain March16,2020 to November1,2021,595calendar days of the qualified legal rule. Publication establishes commencement, extension annotations and DNU678 supply the boundary. Safe-corridor permission is not universal observed gate reopening. Health prevention is explicit in the decree recitals; no private motivation or additional category is assigned. Original DNU274, DNU678 operative provisions and the migration-director pilot explanation were freshly read. The separate bulletinURL failed and contributes no newly inspected wording. Retain unlocated policy geometry and null coordinates. Named countries or general safe corridors do not identify every operating land gate.
